_about: The viewer's CI platforms, read by scripts/ci_publish_latest.cjs to plan build.yaml's build matrix and its publication (doc/release_channels.md). Each platform is one call of viewer-platform.yaml (checks "<name> / build" and "<name> / publish"), uploading <name>-installer with one package ending in package.suffix. tags.main is its vkstorm-release tag; vkstorm-canary and vkstorm-devel publish it as experimental-<tags.line> and preview-<tags.line>. automatic platforms build on every push and pull request, pull_requests platforms on every pull request too (so the on-demand linux-lts build never rots); on workflow_dispatch the input named by dispatch_input selects it. A FreeBSD build (freebsd-latest, planned) is one more entry.

linux.title: Linux
linux._note: Built and linked directly on GitHub's ubuntu-26.04 runner (the newest GitHub runner, bumped by hand when a newer one ships) with the newest GCC its Ubuntu ships and the packages of autobuild.xml, built on ubuntu-26.04. The tag and package keep the name linux-latest / -ubuntu-latest across such bumps. A binary needs at least the glibc and libstdc++ it was built against, so its floor is that runner's; CI reports it.

linux-lts.title: Linux LTS (Ubuntu 24.04)
linux-lts._note: Published on demand, built on every pull request. Built and linked inside ubuntu:24.04 (glibc 2.39, GCC 14) with the 24.04-built packages of scripts/linux_lts_packages.json, so it runs on Ubuntu 24.04 and newer; CI fails it on anything newer than glibc 2.39 or GLIBCXX_3.4.33. The host's preinstalled toolchains are mounted under /host-free so that the disk step can remove them.
